TaskDescription: No task. Segments of seizure activity from presurgical intracranial EEG (set E of Andrzejak et al. 2001), selected from all recording sites exhibiting ictal activity.
iEEGPlacementScheme: Depth electrodes in both hippocampal formations and strip electrodes on the lateral and basal neocortex; set E segments come from contacts of any of these electrodes; the electrode and contact of each segment are not provided.
iEEGElectrodeGroups: Depth electrodes implanted symmetrically into both hippocampal formations and strip electrodes on the lateral and basal regions of the neocortex; set E was taken from contacts of all of these electrodes (Andrzejak et al. 2001, Fig. 2). Number of contacts per electrode not reported.
InstitutionName: Department of Epileptology, University of Bonn
iEEGReference: Average common reference, omitting electrodes containing pathological activity (Andrzejak et al. 2001).
FilterNotes: Andrzejak et al. (2001): 'Band-pass filter settings were 0.53-40 Hz (12 dB/oct.)'. UPF download page: 'The time series you can download here are not filtered. The application of a low-pass filter of 40 Hz, as described in the manuscript, is regarded as the first step of analysis and therefore not carried out for the downloadable time series.' No filter was applied during this conversion.
SubjectArtefactDescription: Segments were selected by the source after visual inspection for artifacts (e.g. muscle activity, eye movements) and had to fulfil a weak-stationarity criterion.
